data.body:
Epic complete. All 11 descendants closed; every AC met by the landed leaves:

- Factory-sourced parsing / no manual syntax authority -> S2 (2635 + cd12/e499-era migrations) + db7f formatter uniformity.
- Overview single-listing + byte-current top-level help -> S2d help generator + overview-coverage contract.
- Exact/compat/hidden/retired spellings (jira-onboard, purge-bridge) -> S5/S6 registry.
- Lazy execution preserves mount/init/argv/confirmation/stream/exit-code/legacy-output -> S5 dispatch + S6 cutover (all 21 intercepts given real dispatch metadata before ladder retirement).
- Optional modes/backends without eager optional imports -> S3 capability registry + import-isolation probes.
- Reference/coverage/lean-wheel/full-extra checks enumerate registries not source regexes -> S2d/S5 generators over ROUTES.
- Duplicate authorities removed after shadow parity; gates pass; no stored-data migration -> S6 cutover.
- ADR 0100 (Accepted) + living architecture record parser/route/capability/migration/compat/rollback boundaries -> S1.

Residual-gap sweep: the one enumerated gap (advanced parsers on stock argparse.HelpFormatter -> latent py3.13 help-generation regression) was FIXED in scope, not merely filed -- db7f (merged 1ab859777a) pinned the four rendered non-bridge advanced factories and added a registry-wide contract test. Intercept-group parsers are dispositioned ACCEPTED out-of-scope: gen_cli_help.py never renders them and gen_cli_reference.py already canonicalizes their live --help cross-version. No other residual gaps.
